name: Meta AI
description: Native OpenClaw provider for Meta AI chat (Muse Spark / Llama) with optional image and video generation commands. Backed by the mir-ashiq/metaai-api Python FastAPI sidecar bound to 127.0.0.1.

pythonBin.description: Python interpreter to use for the metaai-api sidecar (default: 'python3' on PATH).

host.description: Host the metaai-api sidecar binds to. Locked to 127.0.0.1 by default; only override for explicit local-loopback variants like 'localhost' or '::1'.

port.description: Optional fixed port for the metaai-api sidecar. Default: ephemeral random port.

openAiProxyPort.description: Optional fixed port for the in-process OpenAI-compatible proxy that fronts the sidecar.

idleShutdownMs.description: Shut the sidecar down after this many milliseconds of inactivity. 0 disables idle shutdown.

startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the sidecar to become healthy on first call.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables to pass to the sidecar process. Cookie values must NOT be set here; they are read from the OpenClaw secret/env mechanism.

defaultModel.description: Default Meta AI model id surfaced to OpenClaw (e.g. 'metaai/muse-spark').

allowedModels.description: Optional allowlist of Meta AI model ids that this plugin is permitted to register.
